item.title: How to read your Instagram engagement rate
item.description: Engagement rate is average likes plus comments per post divided by followers. Compare it with accounts of similar size. A drop after a follower spike often means inactive or fake followers.

item.title: Clean your following list: why non-followers matter
item.description: Accounts that never follow back or engage add little reach. Review non-followers regularly and keep real, active accounts.

item.title: Instagram adds comment editing for a short time after posting
item.description: Instagram has announced that users can edit a comment shortly after posting it. Reports say the edit is limited to text and has a short time window, and that it was tested before the wider launch. Cleaner comment sections may follow, but features reach accounts in stages, so check your own app.

item.title: Instagram launches Features, a long-form video format
item.description: On 26 October 2026 Instagram announced Features, a long-form horizontal video format. Reports say creators can upload videos up to 90 minutes and that Reels will help people discover the longer videos. Availability varies by country. If it brings new audience, track new followers and engagement over time to see the real effect.
